limits: The two bundle hashes and their shared payload identity are pinned by the native catalog. This fixture does not repeat GPU pixel readback.
Native compatible-alias cases use the same bundle and exact selector. Separate managed scheduler tests cover sharing compatible declared samplers across distinct bundle hashes and selectors.
Mismatch injection changes only the loader-owned untransferred texture in memory. Each failed candidate is rejected before ownership transfer and destroyed by asynchronous bundle unloading.
Fixture retirement destroys only exact registered transferred textures with empty AssetDatabase paths after two editor updates. Production deferred retirement behavior remains unchanged.
The fixture compares loaded scene handles, paths and dirty flags, active scene, selection, active render target, sRGB write state and loaded bundle instance IDs after cleanup.
Normal textures provide matching payloads with distinct samplers for this loader test. Runtime material bindings remain albedo-only.
Recorded payload accounting is not a measurement of total engine memory, VRAM or frame-time performance.
